{
  "name": "ai-werewolf-arena-backend",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Backend game engine for AI Werewolf Arena",
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc",
    "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run check:tests",
    "check:tests": "tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit",
    "test": "bun test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests",
    "lint:deps": "eslint \"src/**/*.ts\" --max-warnings=0",
    "lint:boundaries": "bun scripts/check_import_boundaries.mjs",
    "smoke": "bun src/app/cli/run-game-smoke.ts",
    "release:check": "bun run check && bun run lint:deps && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run lint:i18n && bun run test && bun run smoke",
    "run": "bun src/app/cli/run-game.ts",
    "export:replay": "bun src/app/cli/export-replay-bundle.ts",
    "run:six": "bun src/app/cli/run-game.ts --game-config-name six_player_mvp",
    "run:twelve": "bun src/app/cli/run-game.ts --game-config-name twelve_player_standard",
    "run:twelve:acp": "bun src/app/cli/run-game.ts --game-config-name twelve_player_codex_acp",
    "run:mock": "bun src/app/run-mock-game.ts",
    "test:watch": "bun test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests --watch",
    "test:coverage": "bun test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests --coverage",
    "config:check": "bun src/app/cli/check-config.ts",
    "config:migrate": "bun src/app/cli/migrate-configs.ts",
    "simulate": "bun src/app/cli/simulate.ts",
    "replay:actions": "bun src/app/cli/replay-actions.ts",
    "lint:i18n": "bun scripts/check_i18n_literals.mjs",
    "test:unit": "bun --no-env-file test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests/unit",
    "test:integration": "bun --no-env-file test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests/integration",
    "test:scenarios": "bun --no-env-file test --preload ./tests/setup.ts tests/scenarios"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@agentclientprotocol/sdk": "^1.5.1",
    "@ai-werewolf-arena/replay-contract": "workspace:*",
    "@ai-sdk/anthropic": "^4.0.65",
    "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible": "^3.0.57",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.30.1",
    "ai": "^7.0.118",
    "zod": "^4.6.5",
    "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-catalog": "workspace:*",
    "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-text": "workspace:*",
    "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-contract": "workspace:*",
    "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-presentation": "workspace:*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "bun-types": "^1.4.2",
    "@types/node": "^20.19.43",
    "@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.70.1",
    "eslint": "^9.39.5",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3"
  }
}

/**
 * 负责历史复盘的阶段、角色、阵营与结束原因标签到稳定标识的精确转换。
 * 输入为单个已归档标签，输出为已知标识或原字符串；本模块拥有这些兼容表，角色表独立维护。
 * 不扫描玩家或模型正文，不模糊匹配未知标签，也不据旧标签推导真实身份、许可或游戏规则。
 */
import { LEGACY_ROLE_ALIASES } from "./legacy_role_aliases";

const phases: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Object.freeze({
  夜晚: "night",
  白天: "day",
  投票: "voting",
  终局: "game_over",
  Night: "night",
  Day: "day",
  Voting: "voting",
  "Game over": "game_over",
});
// 阶段表继承原阶段名称，再补具体行动标签；同一个旧标签只能按这里的精确拼写转换。
const stages: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Object.freeze({
  ...phases,
  放逐投票: "voting",
  "Exile vote": "voting",
  白天发言: "day_speech",
  "Day speech": "day_speech",
  遗言: "last_words",
  "Last words": "last_words",
  猎人开枪: "hunter_shot",
  "Hunter shot": "hunter_shot",
  狼人交流: "wolf_discussion",
  "Wolf discussion": "wolf_discussion",
  狼人刀人投票: "wolf_vote",
  "Wolf kill vote": "wolf_vote",
  守卫行动: "guard",
  "Guard action": "guard",
  预言家行动: "seer",
  "Seer action": "seer",
  女巫行动: "witch",
  "Witch action": "witch",
  警长竞选: "sheriff",
  "Sheriff election": "sheriff",
  上警报名: "sheriff_nomination",
  "Sheriff nomination": "sheriff_nomination",
  警上发言: "sheriff_campaign_speech",
  "Sheriff campaign speech": "sheriff_campaign_speech",
  退水: "sheriff_withdraw",
  "Withdraw candidacy": "sheriff_withdraw",
  警长投票: "sheriff_vote",
  "Sheriff vote": "sheriff_vote",
  警长定序: "sheriff_choose_direction",
  "Sheriff speaking order": "sheriff_choose_direction",
  天亮后窗口: "on_daybreak",
  "Daybreak window": "on_daybreak",
  警长流程前窗口: "on_pre_election",
  "Before sheriff election": "on_pre_election",
  放逐前窗口: "on_pre_vote",
  "Before exile voting": "on_pre_vote",
  发言间隔窗口: "on_per_speech_gap",
  "Between speeches": "on_per_speech_gap",
  初始角色: "god_private_game_info",
  "Initial roles": "god_private_game_info",
  夜晚结算: "night_resolved",
  "Night resolution": "night_resolved",
});

const camps: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Object.freeze({
  好人: "good",
  好人阵营: "good",
  Good: "good",
  "Good team": "good",
  狼人: "wolf",
  狼人阵营: "wolf",
  Werewolves: "wolf",
  "Werewolf team": "wolf",
  第三方: "third_party",
  第三方阵营: "third_party",
  "Third party": "third_party",
  "Third party team": "third_party",
});
const reasons: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Object.freeze({
  狼人全部出局: "all_wolves_eliminated",
  "All wolves eliminated": "all_wolves_eliminated",
  好人全部出局: "all_good_eliminated",
  "All good players eliminated": "all_good_eliminated",
  屠边条件达成: "slaughter_side_completed",
  "All good special roles or all villagers eliminated": "slaughter_side_completed",
  狼人达半: "wolves_reach_half",
  "Living wolves reach parity": "wolves_reach_half",
  达到最大天数: "max_days_reached",
  "Maximum day count reached": "max_days_reached",
  运行异常: "runtime_error",
  "Runtime error": "runtime_error",
  达到运行期限: "runtime_timeout",
  "Runtime deadline reached": "runtime_timeout",
  已完成: "completed",
  Completed: "completed",
  进行中: "in_progress",
  "In progress": "in_progress",
});
// 只承认表自身条目，避免把 toString 等原型属性误当历史标识；未知值保持原文。
const alias = (map: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, value: string): string =>
  Object.hasOwn(map, value) ? map[value] : value;
export const legacyPhaseId = (value: string): string => alias(phases, value);
export const legacyStageId = (value: string): string => alias(stages, value);
export const legacyRoleId = (value: string): string => alias(LEGACY_ROLE_ALIASES, value);
export const legacyCampId = (value: string): string => alias(camps, value);
export const legacyResultReasonId = (value: string): string => alias(reasons, value);

/**
 * 维护已发布 v1 角色显示名称到稳定角色标识的兼容快照，供历史复盘 reader 精确查询。
 * 本模块唯一拥有这张冻结表；中英文旧名称都是历史输入，不能翻译或替换已有条目。
